description: Defines the User class representing a logged-in user in the Sigma Banking app, with serialization/deserialization methods and copyWith functionality.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Model class for a user, including fields such as id, email, displayName, kycCompleted, and methods for JSON serialization and copying.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the User with optional updated fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the User instance into a JSON-compatible map.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a User instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Serializes a User object to a JSON string.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into a User object.
